findings.issue: FORWARD-OBLIGATION comment annotates only the export route. Does not mention that GET /api/audit and GET /api/audit/:instanceId (pre-existing routes, lines 272-277 and 330-338) are also unauthenticated in dev mode. All three routes need PDP gating at production hardening time.
findings.suggestion: Add to registerAuditRoutes docstring or FORWARD-OBLIGATION: 'NOTE: GET /api/audit and GET /api/audit/:instanceId are also unauthenticated in dev mode and MUST receive a PDP gate at production hardening together with export'.

findings.issue: Module docstring states 'PDP gate: same principal as GET /api/audit' — misleading because GET /api/audit has no principal check at all (no x-dev-user required). Export is actually stricter than the screen-read endpoint.
findings.suggestion: Rephrase to: 'In dev mode: export requires x-dev-user (401 otherwise); screen-read [GET /api/audit] is open without a gate — both routes will receive a PDP gate at production hardening'.

acceptance_coverage.ac: export-AC-6: /api/audit/:id not captured by export route

role_gap_evidence: audit-export authz asymmetry: GET /api/audit/export has x-dev-user gate; GET /api/audit and GET /api/audit/:instanceId do not. Consistent only in that all audit routes lack PDP — the asymmetry is a documentation gap, not a security regression vs pre-existing pattern. FORWARD-OBLIGATION comments cover production hardening obligation. No systematic security class gap requiring a separate security-reviewer role at this time.
